description:
Cast Armed with Proof by paying {2}{W}.
When Armed with Proof enters, it triggers, creating two Clue tokens.
When the Clues enter as Equipment due to Armed with Proof, their living weapon abilities given by them to Ekthi each trigger.
Resolve the first living weapon trigger, creating a Clue token due to Flitwing.
When the Clue enters as an Equipment, its living weapon ability triggers, creating a Clue token.
Repeat step 5.
